seo.title: Case Study: Babaria — Website for a Cosmetics Brand | Máximo Silva
seo.description: How I built the institutional section for Babaria, a cosmetics brand with over 40 years of history, to strengthen its identity and build customer trust.

hero.title: Babaria — reinforcing the brand identity
hero.subtitle: A cosmetics brand with over 40 years of history in Spain that needed to strengthen its digital presence and better communicate its brand identity.

desafio.title: The Challenge
desafio.texto: Babaria had decades of history and market recognition, but its digital communication didn't fully convey that story. They lacked a space of their own to explain who they were, what ingredients they used, and why customers should choose their products, beyond the e-commerce storefront.

solucion.title: The Solution
solucion.texto: I built an 'About Us' section focused on telling the company's story, highlighting its key ingredients, and conveying its values through visual content and video. The focus was on helping visitors understand who's behind the brand before making a purchase decision.
incluye: Visual content and video to reinforce the narrative
Design aligned with the existing visual identity
Structure designed to build trust before purchase

resultado.title: The Result
resultado.texto: The brand strengthened its digital identity with an institutional section that builds trust and connection with its products, helping visitors make their purchase decision with more information about who's behind Babaria.
